name: lineagelens
description: AI code intelligence platform — git blame for AI-generated code. Captures every AI insertion and traces it back to its prompt, model, and developer. Works with any editor, any AI tool, any team.

commands.title: AI Insertion Detector: Open Provenance Search
AI Provenance: Configure Reviewer API Key
AI Provenance: Switch to Backend Mode
AI Provenance: Refresh Local Lineage (Latest Commit)
LineageLens: Migrate Local Records to Backend

aiCodeProvenance.mode.description: Choose storage and features: local (zero-setup) or backend (full power).

aiInsertionDetector.enabled.description: Enable or disable AI insertion detection.

aiInsertionDetector.lineThreshold.description: Minimum net added lines required before an insertion event is captured.

aiInsertionDetector.proxyPort.description: Proxy port used when forwarding captured insertion payloads via HTTP POST.

aiInsertionDetector.localProxy.enabled.description: Enable or disable the local LLM HTTP proxy that intercepts outgoing POST calls.

aiInsertionDetector.localProxy.port.description: Listening port for the local LLM proxy server.

aiInsertionDetector.localProxy.retention.description: How long to keep captured local proxy request/response pairs for insertion correlation, in milliseconds.

aiInsertionDetector.correlation.windowMs.description: Maximum time gap (in milliseconds) allowed between an insertion and captured model response during prompt correlation.

aiInsertionDetector.correlation.similari.description: Minimum Levenshtein similarity score used to boost content-based request correlation when timing matches are ambiguous.

aiInsertionDetector.activation.startupMo.description: Initialization strategy: lazy starts proxy/storage on first extension interaction, eager starts them immediately after activation.

aiInsertionDetector.local.storage.locati.description: Local mode storage location. globalState keeps records in VS Code user data; workspaceFile stores records in .vscode/ai-provenance/records.json; customFile stores records at local.storage.customFilePath.

aiInsertionDetector.local.storage.custom.description: Custom local JSON records file path used when local.storage.location is customFile. Supports absolute paths, relative workspace paths, ~, ${workspaceFolder}, and ${workspaceRoot}.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.baseUrl.description: Base URL for provenance backend APIs used by the sidebar, for example GET /provenance/{uuid} and POST /explain.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.websocketUrl.description: WebSocket endpoint used for primary backend capture ingest.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.ingestPath.description: Relative backend path used for HTTP fallback ingest when WebSocket delivery fails.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.auth.loginPa.description: Relative backend authentication endpoint used by the login command when requesting JWT tokens.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.auth.registe.description: Relative backend registration endpoint used when creating new per-user accounts from the extension.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.auth.refresh.description: Relative backend endpoint used to refresh expired access tokens using a refresh token.
How many seconds before token expiration the extension should proactively refresh access tokens.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.auth.autoAcq.description: Attempt backend authentication preflight on extension activation using any stored JWT token.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.retry.websoc.description: Maximum number of WebSocket ingest attempts before switching to HTTP fallback.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.retry.httpAt.description: Maximum number of HTTP fallback ingest attempts after WebSocket failures.

aiInsertionDetector.backend.vectorSearch.description: Relative backend endpoint path for vector similarity search used by the provenance search panel.

aiInsertionDetector.local.explanation.pr.description: Local explanation mode: templated summary (default) or local Ollama request with templated fallback.

aiInsertionDetector.local.ollama.url.description: Local Ollama generate endpoint used for local provenance explanations.

aiInsertionDetector.local.ollama.model.description: Ollama model name used for local provenance explanation generation.

aiInsertionDetector.local.ollama.timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for local Ollama explanation requests.

aiInsertionDetector.reviewer.provider.description: Current-file reviewer provider. Use 'openai' for OpenAI, 'anthropic' for Anthropic Claude, 'ollama' for local Ollama, 'openai-compatible' for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or 'heuristic' for the built-in rule-based review.

aiInsertionDetector.reviewer.apiUrl.description: Override the chat completions endpoint used by the reviewer. Leave empty to use the default for the selected provider.

aiInsertionDetector.reviewer.model.description: Model name used by the reviewer. Defaults: openai=gpt-4o-mini, anthropic=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, ollama=llama3.2.

aiInsertionDetector.reviewer.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for reviewer API requests.

lineagelens.reviewer.provider.description: Reviewer provider (lineagelens namespace). Overrides aiInsertionDetector.reviewer.provider when set.

lineagelens.reviewer.model.description: Model override for the reviewer (lineagelens namespace). Leave empty to use provider default.

lineagelens.reviewer.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama API endpoint for the reviewer when lineagelens.reviewer.provider is 'ollama'.

lineagelens.reviewer.timeoutMs.description: Timeout override (ms) for reviewer requests in the lineagelens namespace. Set to 0 to use aiInsertionDetector.reviewer.timeoutMs.

scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run bundle
scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run bundle
scripts.package:web: npm run compile && npx @vscode/vsce package --target web
scripts.package:win32-x64: npm run compile && npx @vscode/vsce package --target win32-x64
scripts.package:linux-x64: npm run compile && npx @vscode/vsce package --target linux-x64
scripts.package:darwin-arm64: npm run compile && npx @vscode/vsce package --target darwin-arm64
